english: Your bill was sent as usual. A WASAC officer may follow this up; you don't need to do anything.
kinyarwanda: Fagitire yawe yoherejwe nk'uko bisanzwe. Umukozi wa WASAC ashobora kubikurikirana; nta kindi usabwa gukora.

english: This reading was already billed. Close it once you have followed up, for example by visiting the meter.
kinyarwanda: Iki gipimo cyamaze gukorerwa fagitire. Gifunge umaze kugikurikirana, urugero usura mubazi.

english: Keys: J next, K previous, A accept, R reject, C close, U undo.
kinyarwanda: Utubuto: J ikurikira, K ibanziriza, A emeza, R anga, C funga, U subiza inyuma.
